subject: Purchase reference activation: provisional PO request, spend hold and line-item SKU mismatch
summary: Vendor requests provisional PO assignment for onboarding while procurement completes spend-cap approvals. Internal team reconciles SKU/line-item codes and issues provisional PO with temporary spend hold; follow-ups include corrected invoice lines and onboarding form.
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@altitude-cloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@altitude-cloud.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for provisional PO & spend cap during onboarding

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — excited to get started. Our procurement team asked me to request a provisional purchase reference so we can begin provisioning while our internal legal and finance finish up net-30 paperwork.

Key details:
- Estimated first-month spend: $12,500 (we expect heavy usage in week 2).
- Suggested spend cap for provisional: $20,000.
- Line items we will bill under: INFERENCE-GPU (qty variable), DATA-EGRESS (monthly estimate). I attached a CSV with the vendor invoice lines we typically use.

Can Redwood assign a provisional PO number (or purchase-ref) and apply a spend hold that we can increase once finance signs off? Also please share any onboarding forms we should return.

Attached: altitude_invoice_lines.csv

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Procurement
Altitude Cloud
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@altitude-cloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for provisional PO & spend cap during onboarding

Hi Sanjay — appreciate the note and the CSV. Looping in Kimberly from procurement ops to help with provisional PO issuance and spend cap controls.

Kimberly — can you provision a temporary purchase-ref and set an initial spend cap at $20,000 pending Altitude's finance approval? Also confirm which SKU mapping we should use for the INFERENCE-GPU and DATA-EGRESS items (our catalog uses codes RL-GPU-1 and OUT-EGR-2 typically).

Sanjay — I attached our onboarding form (fillable PDF) in case that speeds reviews. If finance needs a DocuSign, Kimberly will drop the link.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@altitude-cloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for provisional PO & spend cap during onboarding

Hi all — happy to take this on. Process and next steps:

1) Provisional purchase-ref: we can issue a provisional PO (format PR-YYYY-####) with an initial spend hold. I will issue PR-2026-8347 at $20,000 as requested.
2) Spend adjustments: once Altitude's finance returns the signed onboarding form / DocuSign, we can convert provisional PR into a standard PO and lift or adjust the cap.
3) SKU mapping: please use our catalog codes RL-GPU-1 for "Inference GPU" and OUT-EGR-2 for "Data Egress". Laura and I noticed Altitude's CSV has a third column labelled "Account Code" which doesn't match our ledger. Please see the attached onboarding form and the provisional PO stub.

Action items for vendor (Sanjay):
- Return the completed onboarding form (attached) or sign the DocuSign link below.
- If possible, resend the invoice lines with Altitude SKU -> Redwood catalog mapping in the third column so Laura can validate ledger mapping.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/some-doc-id-abc123
Attached: altitude_onboarding_form_filled.pdf, provisional_po_8347.pdf

Best,
Kimberly Park
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@altitude-cloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for provisional PO & spend cap during onboarding

Kimberly — thanks. We completed the onboarding form and attached it plus an updated invoice CSV where we map our internal SKU (AC-GPU) to your RL-GPU-1 code. Two quick clarifications:

1) Can the provisional PO be used immediately for initial provisioning (we need to spin up test nodes today)?
2) Can you confirm whether the spend cap will trigger an automatic block or just alert procurement? We prefer alerts for now and hard-block only if it exceeds $25k.

Attachments: altitude_onboarding_form_filled.pdf, altitude_invoice_lines.csv

On Mar 12, 2026, at 10:17 AM, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi all — happy to take this on. Process and next steps:
>
> 1) Provisional purchase-ref: we can issue a provisional PO (format PR-YYYY-####) with an initial spend hold. I will issue PR-2026-8347 at $20,000 as requested.
> 2) Spend adjustments: once Altitude's finance returns the signed onboarding form / DocuSign, we can convert provisional PR into a standard PO and lift or adjust the cap.
>
Thanks,
Sanjay
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for provisional PO & spend cap during onboarding

Quick internal note — I reviewed Altitude's updated CSV. Two discrepancies to correct before we finalize ledger coding:

- Row 4: Altitude AC-GPU should map to RL-GPU-1 (they mapped it to RL-GPU-2 by mistake).
- Row 7: They combined egress and support under one line; we need separate line items for OUT-EGR-2 (egress) and SUP-ONB-1 (onboarding support) for billing clarity.

I'll prepare a corrected CSV and reattach. Kimberly, please hold the provisional PR-2026-8347 in alert-only mode (no hard block) and set an auto-notify at 80% of spend cap ($16,000). Once we have the corrected lines and DocuSign signed, we convert to a standard PO.

Attached: altitude_invoice_lines_corrected.csv

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@altitude-cloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for provisional PO & spend cap during onboarding

Sanjay — thanks for the quick turnaround and the completed form. Per Laura/Kimberly:

- Provisional PR-2026-8347 is live and set to alert-only at $20,000 with an 80% notify threshold ($16,000). No hard block unless you request or we hit $25,000.
- Laura uploaded a corrected invoice CSV; please confirm the mapping for rows 4 and 7 so we can finalize ledger mapping.
- Once your finance signs the DocuSign link, procurement will convert the provisional PR into a standard PO and remove the provisional flag.

Let me know if you want PR number in a different format for your AP system; we can also provide a temporary accounting reference field if needed.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
